pdf-editor.workedExample:
Place a signature image 30% wide on an A4 page (595.28 × 841.89 pt), at X 60%, Y 10%, with a 3:1 aspect ratio:
image width = 0.30 × 595.28 = 178.58 pt
image height = 178.58 ÷ 3 = 59.53 pt
x = 0.60 × 595.28 = 357.17 pt from the left
y = 0.10 × 841.89 = 84.19 pt from the bottom
The signature lands bottom-right, 179 × 60 pt in size.
